title: Family in Cemetery Near Coleman Gravestone, 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: An early 1920s black and white vintage snapshot capturing two women and two young children seated along a low stone ledge in a shaded cemetery setting. In the background, a prominent grave marker bears the name COLEMAN, honoring Frank and Matilda Coleman. The group is dressed in typical early 1920s attire, featuring knitted sweaters, cloche and straw hats, and a long plaid skirt.
